response.overview: One of the most convenient ways to communicate onboard is through the Norwegian for Me mobile app +1-866-829-1280 (US) or +44-[204]-586-5316 UK. This app is specifically designed for Norwegian Cruise Line guests and works using the ship's internal Wi-Fi network +1-866-829-1280 (US) or +44-[204]-586-5316 UK. Stateroom Phones: You can call directly +1-866-829-1280(US) between stateroom phones by dialing the cabin number. You can communicate with your family on a Norwegian Cruise Line using the onboard app or by calling +1-866-829-1280 (USA) The app supports messaging between devices. Communicating on a Norwegian Cruise Line is easiest using the free Norwegian Cruise Line app, +1-866-829-1280(US) or ++44-[204]-586-5316 (UK) which works on the ship's internal network without requiring an expensive internet package.
